text_block_list.text:
Entering the trainer's room early to 
prepare for afternoon training, I found 
Ikuno Dictus already there waiting.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer-san. I had planned to pick 
this up from the dry cleaner's today.

As Ikuno Dictus said that, her gaze 
dropped down to her racing outfit.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"...I was just taking a moment to deeply 
reflect on the feelings woven into these 
racing silks."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Coming up with the design took a lot of 
effort. Do you remember? You helped me out 
as well, Trainer—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno's Former Teacher
text_block_list.text: "The Racewear design... entrusted to me?"

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Yes. I've been troubled by something.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I thought that you, of all people, might 
have a design concept that truly suits me. 
Would you be willing to help?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno's Former Teacher
text_block_list.text:
"I hear you... However, I'm going to have 
to decline this time."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: !? No way...! Why would you say that?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno's Former Teacher
text_block_list.text:
"As I said, I've known you for a very long 
time."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno's Former Teacher
text_block_list.text:
"Still, wouldn't the person who knows the 
current you best not be me?"

text_block_list.name: Ikuno's Former Teacher
text_block_list.text:
"Fufu, no matter what design it turns out 
to be, I'm looking forward to seeing you 
shine brightly in your racing outfit!"

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: (The one who knows me best right now...)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
! Ah, no. ...Was it showing on my face? I 
didn't mean for it to.
choice_data_list:
Even I can tell something's different from 
usual.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Just as I thought, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
No, more importantly, there's something 
I'd like to consult you on. I'm having a 
bit of trouble with the design of my 
racing outfit.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"Racewear is also something that 
represents who I am. Building it from 
scratch to match my appearance was 
difficult."
choice_data_list:
In that case... could you give me a few 
days?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Trainer, excuse me—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Ngh! What is with all these documents?!
choice_data_list:
It's my trainee's racing outfit, so I'm 
extra fired up!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
All this... Just how much time did you 
spend on it...?
choice_data_list: So... did you find one you liked?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
This suits my personal tastes as well, so 
it looks quite nice.
choice_data_list: Alright! Let's win big with that!

Yeah! Let's go and win lots of races with 
that!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"......No, I'm sorry. Just a little bit 
longer."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
There are some parts... I'd like to adjust 
myself. Would that be alright?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe.
choice_data_list:
Come to think of it, where did you make 
adjustments?

Come to think of it, where did you make 
adjustments?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: It's the red of this lining.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"A burning red... The color of passion, as 
I see it..."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I modeled this after the burning passion 
for victory from all the people who 
support me.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
When I run, I harbor this burning passion 
within me and run.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: This is a promise, and a mission...!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
It's precisely because I poured those 
feelings into it that looking at it helps 
me brace myself anew.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
And that is why I feel like I can give 
today's training my all.
choice_data_list: Then I'd better stay sharp too.
Then I need to brace myself too.
Keep that up and let's win the next race!
Keep that up and let's win the next race!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
And that is why I feel like I can give 
today's training my all.
choice_data_list: Then I'd better stay sharp too.
Then I need to brace myself too.
Keep that up and let's win the next race!
Keep that up and let's win the next race!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
...Yes. I would be very grateful if you 
could do so.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"I shall strive hard as well, so as not to 
fall behind Trainer-san."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Of course. As long as I have this burning 
passion, I will keep running.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Aiming for victory...!
